title: Verificación: 21 t/s on RTX 4060 Gemma 4 not the full story - TTFT brutal on longer prompts
summary: Claim revisado: Gemma 4 12B Q4_K_M delivers solid 21 t/s inference on consumer RTX 4060 (llama.cpp). Evidencia: User reports running similar Q4 setup for transaction parsing; TTFT on 400-token system prompt was 'brutal' on comparable hardware. Asks specifically about longer contexts.. Caveat editorial: Generation speed (tok/s) can look good while TTFT/prefill on realistic prompts (system + context) is poor; questions real-world usability beyond raw decode speed.. Reproducibilidad: medium - anecdotal but directly tied to the exact claim and hardware class.
